structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The movement emphasizes how thoughtful zoning keeps a compact apartment open, bright, and comfortably divided into distinct personal areas.
structured_intent.initial_state: A static open-plan interior presents the full bed zone on the left and dining zone on the right, separated by a narrow foreground timber divider.
structured_intent.primary_action: The viewpoint shifts laterally to the right across the visible depth of the zoned interior.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The divider appears modestly farther left in the frame while the full bed and dining zones remain visible in nearly their initial proportions.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The floor-to-ceiling timber divider remains vertically anchored between the bed zone and dining zone.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Both zones remain equally legible as complementary parts of one spacious, practical apartment.

prompt.positive: The stabilized camera drifts laterally to the right from the first frames, moving evenly and decelerating only during the final half-second, with no pan, push-in, zoom, or orbit. By the final frame, the foreground timber divider has shifted left by about 6% of the frame width while the full bed and dining zones remain readable in nearly their original proportions; curtains have no independent motion and rigid geometry does not deform.
